h1: Angola tourist visa from the UK
intro: Planning a holiday or a visit to family or friends in Angola? This page explains the Angola tourist visa, who needs one and what to prepare. We check the rules for your passport and apply for you.
eligibility: You are travelling for a holiday, sightseeing or to visit family or friends
You won’t work or do business during your visit
You have a return ticket and enough money for your stay

sections.heading: Do you need an Angola tourist visa?
sections.text: British passport holders don't need a visa to visit Angola as tourists for up to 30 days. You'll still need a visa if you're travelling for business or work, or staying longer.

sections.heading: What an Angola tourist visa covers
sections.text: An Angola tourist visa is for holidays, sightseeing and visiting family or friends in Angola. It doesn't cover business meetings or paid work. If you're travelling for business, see our [Angola business visa](/angola-business-visa-uk/) page.

sections.heading: UK residents on other passports
sections.text: UK residents travelling on other passports may need a visa, depending on their nationality. Business and work visas need an invitation from the Angolan company and are applied for in advance.

sections.heading: Angola tourist visa help from Manchester
sections.text: We're based in Manchester city centre and handle Angola tourist visa applications for travellers across the UK, entirely online. Before you travel, read the UK government's [foreign travel advice](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice) for Angola.

documentsTable.details: Passport photo page scan, valid for at least 6 months
Completed and checked by us before submission
Hotel booking, or an invitation from the people you’re visiting

faqs.q: Can I visit family on an Angola tourist visa?
faqs.a: Yes. Visiting family or friends is covered by the Angola tourist visa.

faqs.q: Can I work in Angola on an Angola tourist visa?
faqs.a: No. Working needs a work visa or permit. Contact us and we’ll explain the options.

faqs.q: How long does an Angola tourist visa take?
faqs.a: Usually a few working days, but processing times vary. Apply at least a week before you travel, and earlier in busy seasons.
